# Season Shelf 1.2.4

This update fixes channel scans that can stop before finding episode files.

- Skip empty Telegram message placeholders and continue paging through channel history, including short pages.
- Report unreadable or stalled history responses as errors instead of silently completing an incomplete scan.
- Preserve detection of episodes posted in mixed quality batches. Files with missing quality information remain available under Unverified.

After updating, rescan affected channels to rebuild their episode lists.

Windows installations can update from within the app. On macOS, download the universal DMG and replace the app in Applications. The builds remain unsigned and the macOS build is not notarized.
